name: SWEEP-S6v1 Roommates
_design: One meaningful interaction, four times over: 8 identical agents start as 4 pairs, each pair on one point with one tree (plus 4 trees elsewhere). A tree cannot feed two. Question: does each pair share, split up, trade or fight, and do the four pairs choose differently?
